summary: ATIF Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing a July 30, 2026 acquisition agreement to acquire all equity of GoldCoin Labs (BVI), a gold-tokenization platform indirectly owned by Metra Group, after an earlier LOI with Metra expired. Consideration is 2,815,005 ordinary shares, valued at $20 million based on a five-day VWAP, issued under Regulation S. The board obtained a fairness opinion from Pinetree Advisory and unanimously approved; a lock-up applies post-closing. Watch for regulatory and custody hurdles to GoldCoin's GOLDM token, plus share-price impact of the stock consideration.
